professionalSummary: Three years of experience as a Mortgage Underwriting Analyst in a retail bank’s residential lending team, consistently preparing underwriting assessments for approximately 700 applications annually in line with the bank’s lending policy and assessment procedure.
experienceHighlights: Prepared underwriting assessments for ~700 applications per year, ensuring compliance with lending policy and assessment procedure.
Verified income and property documents for each application using the established verification standard and completed verification checklists.
Communicated declined or conditioned outcomes to mortgage advisers, managing adviser escalations and maintaining a record of all interactions.
Referred cases outside policy or above mandate to senior underwriters, documenting referral reasons and mandate boundaries.
Documented open items and hand‑over conditions for each case transferred to another analyst or senior underwriter.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Provided two anonymised case files (assessment, verification checklist, adviser call note, referral record) and an adviser escalation log extract, demonstrating full underwriting workflow and system references.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume, work samples, and interview notes establish the candidate’s experience and actions directly related to the role’s requirements; they do not provide evidence of performance metrics beyond volume or of any additional responsibilities outside the stated duties.

decisionBoundary.statement: Candidate’s evidence supports all role requirements; human review recommended to assess fit and potential gaps.

evidence.text: Mortgage underwriting analyst in a retail bank's residential lending team for three years, preparing the underwriting assessments for about seven hundred applications a year against the lending policy under the assessment procedure.

Work sample: two anonymised case files (assessment, verification checklist, adviser call note, referral record) and the adviser escalation log extract, with the underwriting system references as a verification trail.
Verified the income and property documents on each application under the verification standard, with the verification checklist completed on each case file.

Work sample: two anonymised case files (assessment, verification checklist, adviser call note, referral record) and the adviser escalation log extract, with the underwriting system references as a verification trail.

Explained the declined and conditioned outcomes to the mortgage advisers on the adviser line, with the adviser escalations logged; eleven escalations in three years, none upheld against the assessment.

Interviewer 1 note: in the adviser role‑play the candidate stated the policy clause the decline rested on, listed the two documents that would reopen the case, kept the same explanation when the adviser repeated the objection, and closed by summarising the next step for the adviser.
Referred the cases outside policy or above my mandate to the senior underwriter, recording the referral reason and the mandate on each case.

Reference call with the former underwriting team leader: confirmed the candidate prepared the assessments and handled the adviser line in the period, that referrals above mandate went to the senior underwriter, and confirmed the employment dates.
Wrote the open items note and the hand‑over conditions on each case passed to another analyst or to the senior underwriter.

Work sample: two anonymised case files (assessment, verification checklist, adviser call note, referral record) and the adviser escalation log extract, with the underwriting system references as a verification trail.
